verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is homepage marketing saying Mixpanel agents 'monitor your product continuously' and 'surface insights before you think to ask', with an example insight about a 19% signup dip. That loosely implies proactive detection of metric changes. Nothing documents dashboard subscriptions, configurable alert thresholds, anomaly detection, or how alerts are delivered. missing for 10: documented dashboard subscriptions/scheduled delivery, configurable metric alerts or anomaly detection, alert delivery channels (email/Slack), first-party docs beyond marketing copy, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a product-manager, I can subscribe to dashboards and get alerted when a key metric moves abnormally

citations.quote: Agents monitor your product continuously, surface insights before you think to ask, and tell your team exactly what to do next.
Diagnose what changed, and why, in seconds, delivered as a dashboard you and your team can keep working from.
